mechanism: Armodafinil inhibits CYP3A4, increasing sildenafil plasma concentrations and potentiating vasodilatory and hemodynamic effects; both agents may cause additive cardiovascular stress and CNS stimulation.
action: Monitor for sildenafil toxicity signs (hypotension, syncope, priapism, vision changes) and cardiovascular symptoms; consider sildenafil dose reduction or increased dosing intervals; counsel on avoiding excessive use.
